title: Club FAQ
intro: Clubs are in-game zoo player communities with the ability to help you unlock more content and rewards. Teams of up to 18 members compete against each other to earn high popularity statues and exclusive animal color variants which are needed for Collections. Teammates can group chat, visit each other's main zoos, join club-wide breeding or XP boosting events, and even show off their team's club emblem on special club decorations.
roles_body: There are three different roles: President, Minister, and Club Member. The President has ownership of the club and has the most administrative authority. Ministers can do almost everything the president can, but cannot change the club description or remove the President. Club Members can donate and chat. New members must wait seven days before being granted the ability to donate to contests or fundraisers — all other benefits and abilities are available immediately.
roles_ability_manage_members: Invite new members, remove members, or accept/decline new member applications
roles_ability_assign_role: Assign role of minister or club member
roles_footnote: *New members must wait seven days before being granted the ability to donate to contests or fundraisers. All other benefits and abilities are available immediately upon joining or assigning the role.
assigning_body: The President and ministers can assign roles in the Club Members tab inside the club house. Click the player's name and select the green "Change Role" button. You can make the player a minister, a regular club member, or pass ownership of the entire club to a member by making them the President.
adding_applicants: The president and ministers are notified when the club has new applicants. The Applications tab lets admins tour the applicant's zoo, see their statistics, and read their message. Once accepted, all the applicant's other applications are rescinded and the new member can start chatting. All new members must wait 7 days before being able to donate to fundraisers or contests.
adding_invitations: If you already know the player's alpha-numeric Support ID, a president or minister can send an invite directly via the Applications tab. Note: Only the president can rescind an invitation if sent to the wrong player.
removing_body: The president and ministers can remove players by going to the Club Members tab, selecting the player's name, and clicking "Change Role" then "delete." Once removed, the player's personal club ranking resets to zero, the club shop is locked immediately, and any contest donations that week are lost from the club's score. Some players appreciate a warning before removal.
turnover_title: Leader Tips to Prevent High Turnover
turnover_body: Communicate your expectations to players before they join (or immediately after if they are in-game applicants). Communicating on social media helps with directing the team and sharing club goals. You can institute a trial period where new members and you can assess fit before committing long term. If changing expectations for the entire team, let them know so they can prepare. When removing members, give a warning and explanation when possible, and direct them to social media sites where other clubs are looking for members.
rank_body: Each teammate has a personal Member Rank within the club that levels up as the player earns more Reputation Points. Points are earned by contributing to contests and fundraisers: for every 1,000 coins contributed to a fundraiser, the member earns 10 reputation points; every diamond donated gives 5 reputation points; for each animal donated to a contest, the player earns half the animal's popularity in reputation points (babies give double). Each rank level unlocks new purchasable content in the Club Shop.
shop_body: The Club Shop allows club members to buy decorations and animals from past events. Club items unlock as players increase their personal Member Rank. Some items are needed for Collections. Previous event items are grouped by season. Some decorations display your Club Emblem.
club_level_body: Each club can level up to unlock more member capacity, special items, or event fundraiser capabilities. The maximum club level is 20, but clubs unlock their maximum member capacity of 18 at level 8. Clubs earn XP by competing in contests.
fundraisers_body: Fundraisers provide perks to all club members when activated. Some fundraisers are for permanent items while others are temporary repeatable boosts. Only a president or minister can start a fundraiser. Any club member can donate coins or diamonds. Once a fundraiser goal is met, a president or minister can activate the fundraiser and the perk applies to all members. The higher the club level, the more fundraiser options unlock.
fundraiser_type_capacity: Member Capacity (+1 New Member): Expand the number of members allowed. Half of the 18 member slots require diamonds, the rest only require coins or are already unlocked.
fundraiser_type_stickers: Stickers: Members can use new stickers in the group chat inside the clubhouse.
fundraiser_type_emblems: Emblems: Unlock new options for your club emblem by completing these fundraisers.
fundraiser_type_boosters: Booster Events: 48-hour club-wide events that can be repeatedly activated when enough funds are raised. Only a single 48-hour event can be active at a time. Available boosters: XP Boost (increased XP when cleaning, feeding, and playing with animals) and Breeding Boost (increased chance for successful breedings).
contests_body: Clubs are able to participate in weekly contests which give members exclusive rewards as well as increase the club level. See the Contest FAQ for full details on how contests work.
leaving_body: To leave a club, make sure you are not the club's president. Go to the Club Members tab, select your name, and click the red "leave club" button. If you are the president, you must either assign the presidency to another member or remove all members first. If you are the only member, leaving will delete the club.
leaving_tips_title: Best Practices When Leaving a Club
leaving_tips_body: Before leaving, purchase any Club Shop items you want — you lose access to the Club Shop until you regain your member rank in another club. Jenkins' birthday on July 1 is known to be the best Club Sale of the year. You can calculate coins needed to regain a rank level by dividing the cumulative points for that level by 100. If you are the president and do not want your club to disappear, have a trusted family member make an account and hold the presidency while you try another club.
joining_applying: Search for clubs by selecting the Club Search icon (three houses icon), the third icon from the left in the clubhouse. Select your preferred language, then filter the search settings to find a club that fits your needs.
joining_invitation: If you already know a club leader, provide your Support ID for them to send you a direct invitation. Give the exact case-sensitive alpha-numeric ID from your settings. You cannot receive invitations while already in a club, so leave first.
finding_body: Search social media for Zoo 2 communities to connect with club leaders, or use the Past Contests section (1-2-3 icon, the fifth icon from the left in the clubhouse) to see which teams were recently active and how well they placed in contest rankings.
